"""Public account API response boundary."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from typing import Any

# Explicit allowlist: only these fields are safe to expose publicly.
# Anything not listed here (passwords, secrets, tokens, internal ids, ...)
# is dropped even if present on the input account record.
_PUBLIC_FIELDS = ("id", "username", "display_name", "avatar_url", "created_at")


def serialize_account(account: dict[str, Any]) -> bytes:
    payload = {field: account[field] for field in _PUBLIC_FIELDS if field in account}
    return json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
